date.as_written: śakābde 1586 || ... naipāle vidhuvāṇaratnakalite drībhebhabheṭvaikrame śāke kṣāśuga ‥ labhūmimilite corje ca rākātithau

notes: The colophon contains two conflicting dates: an explicit prose date 'śakābde 1586' (1664 CE), followed by chronogram verses indicating Nepal Era 951 (vidhu-vāṇa-ratna = 1-5-9, c. 1831 CE) and Śaka 1751 (c. 1829 CE). The scribe is unnamed, described only as a 76-year-old ('ṣaṭsaptativārṣikena') acting under the command of 'munirāṭ' ('munirāḍājñāpareṇāmunā'), who transcribed the text from Bengali script ('baṃgālākṣarato bhisāritam').
